method.history: reconstructed from logs (the public RPC keeps minutes of state, so archive state reads are impossible there)
method.validation: reconstruction compared with state read at the end block
method.timestamps: block headers on a 10,000-block grid, linearly interpolated; oracle times are exact (updatedAt)

checks.name: pool tick after the last swap

capitalPlacement.note: NVDA and USDG are kept separate; USD values use the oracle price (frozen when the feed is stale). Out-of-range liquidity earns no fees.

uniswapFeesAndVolume.note: Estimate = sum(LP fee x our active-liquidity share); actual = FeesProcessed gross + uncollected at the end block. Opening/closing fee timing (collected before/after the window) explains part of any gap.

pNVDA.moneyWeightedNote: no supplier mints/redeems in the window, so the money-weighted return equals the time-weighted return
pNVDA.reserveCutNote: the vault keeps reserveFeeBps of collected fees for the loss reserve; the market keeps its reserve factor of borrow interest

pUSDG.moneyWeightedNote: no supplier mints/redeems in the window, so the money-weighted return equals the time-weighted return
pUSDG.reserveCutNote: the vault keeps reserveFeeBps of collected fees for the loss reserve; the market keeps its reserve factor of borrow interest

ledger.returnStatedAs: simple (non-compounded) return on starting equity; no flows, so TWR = IRR

versusHolding.explanation: hold = keep the starting NVDA and USDG; the difference is fees minus reserve cut plus inventory effects

deltaMatchedBenchmark.definition: benchmark holds, at every sample, the same NVDA quantity as the pair and rebalances at the oracle price without fees. The shortfall is a decomposition of inventory P&L, not an extra cost to subtract again.
deltaMatchedBenchmark.caveat: while the feed is stale the benchmark price is frozen, so session gaps appear when the feed resumes

failedOrEventlessTransactions.note: nonce counts every transaction the wallet ever sent (including reverted ones). Transactions that left no vault event are funding-related, reverted, or outside the window; no explorer is reachable, so their gas cannot be itemised.

waitingActions.reason: waits and simulated reverts never reach the chain; they exist only in the keeper's own JSON log. Persist and ingest that journal to count them (handoff 08 section 7).

liquidityPolicy.settlementSwapsNote: settlement swaps are paused in the live pair config, so idle NVDA is NOT counted as USDG redemption capacity, nor the reverse
liquidityPolicy.reserveNote: a borrowing reserve is a floor for new loans and deployments; it is not guaranteed withdrawal coverage

immediateRedemptionCapacity.observed: local cash first, then withdrawForSide for the shortfall (redeem path _redeemTokensLossAware)

borrowingCapacityObserved.note: borrow uses getCash (local cash plus vault-withdrawable) and _prepareFixedLiquidity may unwind the vault synchronously for a shortfall; 6a proposes that new borrowing must NOT depend on a unwind

immediateRedemptionCapacity.observed: local cash first, then withdrawForSide for the shortfall (redeem path _redeemTokensLossAware)

borrowingCapacityObserved.note: borrow uses getCash (local cash plus vault-withdrawable) and _prepareFixedLiquidity may unwind the vault synchronously for a shortfall; 6a proposes that new borrowing must NOT depend on a unwind

scenario_50_40_10.statement: illustrative arithmetic from 00 section 6a, not the live configuration or a proven capacity

ramsesFeesAndVolume.venue: Ramses CL NVDA/USDG (dynamic fee, 50% protocol share)
ramsesFeesAndVolume.protocolShareNote: read from slot0 at the end block; 0 SetFeeProtocol events seen in the window, so it is treated as constant
ramsesFeesAndVolume.lpFeeNote: LP fee = swap fee x (1 - protocol share). Whether that LP share is paid through collect() or through the gauge for staked positions is a fork-test question for handoff 01; this is the economic upper bound, not a proven distributable income.
ramsesFeesAndVolume.rewardNote: RAM is not valued here: without an enforceable distribution mechanism for suppliers its value to them is zero (00 section 3).

operatingCostAssumptions: measured cost per recenter $0.0663, per rebalance $0.0376; checkpoints $0.1428/day while active

uniswapDilutionRealisedRanges.basis: realised ranges, replayed swaps, our share = liquidity / (others + ours)

rollout policy +-1200 / trigger 300.capacitySentence: Uniswap v4 NVDA/USDG 0.30% / rollout policy +-1200 / trigger 300: supports NO tested size ($10 to $500k). Gross fees were about 9% a year at the best size (only 55% of capital deployed on average), but net return versus holding was never positive over the whole window: best case -31.5% a year at $50,000; at $10 keeper cost alone makes it -642%. Weekly sub-windows at $1,000 ranged -58% to -2% a year. over the observed 24-day window with a simplified single-range replay (not the contract's exact code path), measured keeper cost, a 20% reserve cut, RAM valued at zero, and net of the cost of simply holding the deposit. The window had a one-way oracle move of -11.6%, which hurts any range position versus holding; one window is not a forecast.
